passages.provision_quote: The hourly minimum wage for fast food restaurant employees shall be twenty dollars ($20) per hour, effective April 1, 2024.
passages.note: AB 1228 sets a fast-food-sector-only minimum wage with Council-set annual increases, a sector floor rather than the general wage-floor rule.
Wicks is recorded Aye on the Assembly floor concurrence vote for AB 1228, the fast-food-sector minimum wage bill.

rows.reasoning: AB 1228 (2023-2024) establishes a minimum wage only for fast food restaurant employees, a sector/employer-group floor the annex treats as on-question but not showing the person's general wage-floor rule; Wicks's Aye vote on it therefore shows only direction, not a chair on "What approach should government take to the minimum wage?"
